plugin.name: Checking your setup
plugin.description: AAF.esm: found. Advanced Animation Framework plays every scene; Rapport drives it. LooksMenu.esp: found. LooksMenu carries the faces and overlays AAF puts on. F4SE: check this yourself. Rapport is an F4SE plugin: start the game through f4se_loader.exe (0.6.23 on 1.10.163, 0.7.9 on the Anniversary Edition; f4se.silverlock.org). Runtime Database: check this yourself. It finds the game's functions on every version; without its f4rd-runtime.bin the game stops at launch (Nexus 108394). MCM: check this yourself. Optional: Mod Configuration Menu gives Rapport its settings pages and hotkeys; without it everything runs on its defaults. Anatomy.esp: found. Anatomy and its engine are required: the faces, the moans and the body sounds run through them. Anatomy Engine: check this yourself. Its cbp.dll (Data\F4SE\Plugins) is what Anatomy runs on; Rapport tells you in game if it did not start. Commonwealth Moisturizer: check this yourself. Optional: the aftermath on bodies and faces needs it and its BodySlide output.

plugin.name: Scene moans
plugin.description: Both partners moan in their own voice and temperament: two voices, four personas, 419 takes in ten kinds. Each moan's length follows the stroke the Anatomy Engine measured, the one receiving in an anal or rough scene gets a painful-pleasure set, a full mouth makes no sound, and a climax gets its own. Plays through Anatomy's sex sounds (MCM, on by default).

plugin.name: Nobody left naked
plugin.description: AAF puts clothes back only when a scene ends properly. Rapport notes what everyone wears going into any AAF scene, keeps it in your save, and puts back whatever is still missing once AAF lets go of them: after an AAF restart, a scene that never ended, or a save made mid-scene. Never over what they wear now, never an item they no longer carry.

plugin.name: Faces and glances
plugin.description: Rapport rules the faces of everyone in a scene: an expression that fits who they are and what is happening, eyes that meet the partner's now and then, and the face given back when the scene ends.

plugin.name: Voices
plugin.description: Real voiced lines in the game's own dialogue system, by persona and by sex. Named characters with a voice of their own borrow the closest one Rapport has, so nobody stays silent.

plugin.name: Relationships
plugin.description: A relationship between every two people who have touched: it grows with every scene, turns them into lovers, can fall apart, and knows family when it sees it. Chemistry and Overture read it.

plugin.name: The Narrator
plugin.description: One storyteller line on the HUD as a scene starts, with the real reasons and the score part by part; it also says why nothing happened, when a relationship turns, and what bystanders make of it. All four on by default; MCM keeps the history.

plugin.name: Change who they are
plugin.description: Two MCM hotkeys: face anyone and press. One cycles their orientation (straight, bi, gay, their own), the other their persona (romantic, reticent, vulgar, mercantile, their own). Kept in that save only; every mod built on Rapport follows it.

plugin.name: Free camera
plugin.description: In every AAF scene you are in, Rapport's or any other mod's, Rapport takes the camera over from AAF at the first animation: fly it and look around with your usual keys and mouse while the scene plays on. AAF's scripted angles are off, so nothing fights the mouse. When the scene ends you are back in the view you had before it, first or third person. FreeCamera = 0 in Rapport.ini leaves the camera to AAF. Incompatible: Commonwealth Camera's Camera Lag. With it on the mouse cannot turn the camera; turn Camera Lag off in Commonwealth Camera's settings ([CameraLag] bEnabled=0).
